Radio 5 Live,·12 Oct 2026,·61 mins

Mark Chapman is joined by Andros Townsend, Chris Sutton and Rory Smith. The panel are joined by a Manchester City fan to discuss the reaction to their win at Anfield in their first game since being found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial regulations. After an impressive performance at the weekend, can Jordan Henderson help bring some control to Chelsea? We hear from Michael Carrick ahead of a potentially defining week for Manchester United and a Fulham fan as their winless start continues. And Tim Vickery joins the show to talk Corinthians appointing Clarence Seedorf and Brazilian air-con. TIMECODES: 01:29 - How should we react to Manchester City winning? 19:15 - Jordan Henderson's Chelsea breakthrough 26:20 - Arsenal's warm-down injuries 32:50 - Manchester United continue to struggle 44:43 - Should Fulham be panicking? 53:21 - Tim Vickery on Seedorf's return to Brazil
